by_milestone.title: Cloud AI SDLC
by_milestone.description: Closed historical cohort: October 2026 Cloud AI SDLC deliveries that had no milestone.

by_milestone.title: Phase 1 — Analysis & foundation
by_milestone.description: Closed historical cohort: work finished through May 2026 (analysis and early foundation) that had no milestone.

by_milestone.title: Phase 3 — Backend API
by_milestone.description: Closed historical cohort: June 2026 backend API deliveries that had no milestone. SAD Phase 3.

by_milestone.title: Phase 4 — Frontend deliveries (history)
by_milestone.description: Closed historical cohort: July–August 2026 frontend deliveries that had no milestone. Kept off the open Phase 4 train so progress is not inflated.

by_milestone.title: Phase 4 — Modern Frontend
by_milestone.description: Remaining Next.js use-case screens. Reopen milestone #9. Historical July–August work is a separate closed milestone.

by_milestone.title: Phase 5 — Observability & production audit
by_milestone.description: Closed historical cohort: September 2026 observability work and the production-readiness audit wave.

by_milestone.title: Phase 6 — Deprecation
by_milestone.description: Legacy retirement: jpa package and remaining deprecation. Critical production blockers stay on v1.0.

by_milestone.title: Scope — Functional requirements
by_milestone.description: Permanent functional-requirement catalog (RF-*). Not claimable delivery work. Stays open for traceability.

by_milestone.title: Scope — Non-functional requirements
by_milestone.description: Permanent non-functional catalog (RNF-*). Delivery assessment is recorded per theme (security→v1.0, experience→Phase 4, performance→v1.1, platform→Backlog) without moving the catalog onto those trains.

by_milestone.title: Scope — Use cases
by_milestone.description: Permanent use-case catalog (CU). Not claimable delivery work. Stays open for traceability.

by_milestone.title: v1.0 — Production Ready
by_milestone.description: Production gate: critical and high security, data-integrity, and release blockers. Not the home of every high-priority feature.

by_milestone.title: v1.1 — Hardening
by_milestone.description: Hardening after the production gate: medium quality, performance, tests, and docs.
